$comment: Temporary npm audit exceptions. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry. Expired entries fail. Unused entries fail unless provider_variance records reviewed cross-provider evidence.

advisories.reason: No fixed extract-zip release exists. The advisory clears only via @puppeteer/browsers 3.x, which requires Node >=22.12 and would drop the Node 18 and 20 support this skill bundle promises. Reached only when @puppeteer/browsers unpacks a browser archive from the pinned Google CDN download, not from user-supplied input.
advisories.review: Re-evaluate when the bundle drops Node 18, when a patched @puppeteer/browsers 2.x ships, or when GitHub closes alert 2.

provider_variance.reason: GitHub Actions npm audit and GitHub Dependabot report the advisory while local npm audit omits it.
